plainTranslation: Your emotional natures mirror each other. You react the same way, need the same comfort, and feel instantly at home together. Failure mode: shared blind spots - if you both avoid conflict or both spiral, no one holds the other steady. Treasure the resonance and watch the patterns you'll both reinforce.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: You share very similar emotional rhythms, so you tend to feel things at the same time. Deeply comforting, and it can amplify a low mood between you. When you're both down, one of you names it so it doesn't spiral.
tension: The growth here is learning that understanding each other is not the same thing as helping each other grow. Because your emotional instincts are so similar, you may reinforce each other's habits without questioning them. At times that is healing. At other times it can keep both of you stuck in the same mood, the same fear, or the same way of coping. This is one of the harder bonds to walk away from, because it can keep two people together long after the rest of the relationship has stopped working, simply because the comfort feels like home. The challenge is knowing when to offer comfort and when to gently help each other move forward.
advice: This connection works best when safety becomes a place to recover, not a place to hide. Sometimes love is settling in together. Sometimes love is helping each other come back up.
summaryShort: You share very similar emotional rhythms, so you tend to feel things at the same time.
